title: Dutrey's pointers, Eli Rice's band in Milwaukee, and Weatherford
summary: Dutrey gave him pointers; he spent 14 months with Eli Rice in Wisconsin, Minnesota and Michigan, then played briefly at the Dreamland with Weatherford and went unpaid.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, read at my home. And you can imagine, I didn't give Roy a chance to turn it on unless I was asking him something. So Dutre, he was kind of sickly. And he would let me play for him. He'd go back to Curtain and some kind of medicine in hell, a blend in hell, something like asthma. I learned that he was, while in the Navy he was shutting the hole where the gunpowder was and that caused that. So he'd always say to me, he called me Pardner. He'd say Pardner if I had the good lungs that you have in the wind I sure would be glad. He'd say gee but you have nice lungs. I used to play so loud I guess that's why he spoke about my lungs so I was only too glad to sit down in Joe Oliver's band. So later on Joe Oliver got Joy Field to play trombone, and in the meantime I left Chicago and went to Milwaukee, Wisconsin to join Eli Rice band. I stayed with this band for 14 months and I practiced very diligently. We traveled in Wisconsin, Minnesota, and Michigan for 14 months. Eli Rice was a great singer. His son Sylvester was the drummer, Sylvester Rice. So while up there I began to improve, I began to get a little write-ups like in Marquette, Michigan and different places. And I kept in touch with Joe Oliver and I sent him the write-ups. So Johnny Dodds told me one day after I came back, he said, I told Joe you'd make a good trombone player, I said Joe said you never would make a good trombone player. Well I didn't feel insulted because I respected those fellas. And so while I was with Eli Rice band, after 14 months I came back and I joined Weatherford's band. Weatherford was a great pianist. I think he died in Japan or somewhere. I think India. Yeah, India, somewhere. So I played with him at the old Dreamland, about six weeks and ended up not getting my money for the last week. That's all in the game I guess. If I could collect the money that I have in Gary and Milwaukee and different places, I could probably buy me a nice car or something.
